Steam Circuit Padel Pro · world arena set, round 1

Five arenas, five corners of the world

Concept stills for the Godot arena library. Same court, net and cage in every frame — what changes is the sky gradient, the horizon, the scenery and the ground beyond the glass, exactly the axes the nine existing arenas vary on.

Gates G1–G3 passed 5/5Style DNA low-poly, smooth shading, no text/UIDeviations camera height on 2 stills (noted per row)Spend 5 calls, ledger on disk
01

Portale Torii

torii·Kyoto, Japan — dusk
top#0b1026hor#e8734fglow#ffb24dapron#2b2a33

Gates pass. Landmarks land hard: torii colonnade, pagoda, lanterns, petals, crescent moon. Camera reads lower than the game preset — far wall sits mid-frame instead of the upper third.

New kinds: torii (pillars + double crossbeam), pagoda (stacked tapered roofs), lantern (warm lamp), petal (small pink spark).

02

Cortile Medina

medina·Marrakech, Morocco — golden hour
top#f7c884hor#8f3f30glow#3fd0c9apron#c78a5a

Gates pass. Horseshoe arch, date palms, brass lanterns and the turquoise zellige band all land; camera high down-court.

New kinds: arch (torus segment on box jambs), palm (trunk + cone fan), zellige (striped tile band quad).

03

Terrazza Carioca

carioca·Rio de Janeiro, Brazil — midday
top#2fb6d9hor#eaf7ffglow#ffd84dapron#e8d5a8

Gates pass. Sugarloaf ridgeline, palm rows and wave foam land. Camera reads lateral/mid-height rather than down-court — the one framing deviation to remember when recreating.

New kinds: ridge (low-poly prism chain), foam (flat white crescent), cable (thin line quad).

04

Banco Aurora

aurora·Iceland — night
top#04060fhor#123a3cglow#4dffc3apron#0d0f12

Gates pass. Basalt columns, snow ridge, steam plumes and the green-violet aurora ribbons land; court stays readable against the dark palette.

New kinds: basalt (hex prism cluster), aurora (emissive translucent ribbon), steam (existing cloud, grey).

05

Isola Egeo

egeo·Santorini, Greece — midday
top#1f5fd0hor#eef4ffglow#2b5fd9apron#d9d2c4

Gates pass. White cubes, cobalt domes, windmill and bougainvillea land; camera high down-court. Bonus: a sailboat on the caldera sea.

New kinds: island (clustered cubes + blue dome caps), windmill (cylinder + cone + blades), sea (flat band quad).
